Published RW-04 experiment launch/detail/history/cancel contracts, added example payload, and synced Research Workbench readiness docs to contract-published pending BFF implementation.

Reviewer found a contract gap in docs/bff/RW-04-experiment-launch.md: the file lists lifecycle states but does not publish the legal transition graph or terminal-state cancel invariants. Please make the state machine explicit (queued -> running -> completed | failed | canceled), reject invalid transitions, and require allowedActions.canCancel=false for terminal runs before resubmitting for review.

RW-04 contract gap addressed. docs/bff/RW-04-experiment-launch.md now publishes the legal transition graph (queued -> running -> completed | failed | canceled), rejects invalid transitions and repeat terminal cancels, and requires allowedActions.canCancel=false for terminal runs. docs/examples/RW-04-experiment-launch.json now shows terminal history/detail payloads with canCancel=false. Ready for review.

Review requested changes: docs/bff/RW-04-experiment-launch.md currently marks queued -> canceled as illegal, but the launch example returns status=queued with allowedActions.canCancel=true. Resolve the contradiction by choosing one lifecycle semantic and aligning the contract, example payloads, and packet wording before re-handoff.

RW-04 contract contradiction resolved. Changes: (1) docs/bff/RW-04-experiment-launch.md — added queued -> canceled as a legal transition (pre-execution cancel), removed it from illegal transitions, updated Required invariants to document both lifecycle paths (queued->running->completed|failed|canceled and queued->canceled), clarified canCancel invariant covers both queued and running non-terminal states; (2) docs/examples/RW-04-experiment-launch.json — added queued_cancel_response example showing the direct queued->canceled path with canCancel=false in response. All three acceptance criteria are now met: launch/run-status routes published, async state machine and cancel authority are explicit with no internal contradictions, experiment history does not depend on inferred runtime state. Ready for review.

RW-04 review approved. Contract and example payloads now align on queued pre-execution cancel semantics, terminal canCancel invariants, and persisted experiment-history truth. Owner should finalize to done.
